title: Cooper Lighting Recalls Solar/Battery Powered Light Fixtures Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The batteries in the solar-powered light fixtures can overheat and cause the light fixture's housing to melt, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 350,000 (in addition, about 11,963 were sold in Canada).

title: Briggs & Stratton Recalls Portable Generator Fuel Tank Replacement Caps, Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel tank replacement caps lack ventilation holes which allow pressure to build up in the fuel tank, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,000.

title: Canyon Recalls Mountain Bikes Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The chainstays can crack, which can lead to failure of the chainstay, rear wheel detachment and loss of control, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 820.

title: Spiraledge Recalls Yoga Backless Chairs Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The chairs can break at the seat or back welded support rod connecting the back legs of the chair, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 12,400 (in addition, about 120 were sold in Canada).

title: Cracker Barrel Old Country Store Recalls Decorative Pineapples Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The metal leaves on top of the pineapples have sharp edges, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 1,500.

title: Marker Recalls Kingpin Ski Bindings Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The steel pins in the toe unit can break and reduce the release force of the binding, causing a fall hazard. Units: About 4,100 (in addition, about 2,200 were sold in Canada).

title: Metal Playground Climbers Recalled by BCI Burke Due to Strangulation Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The two welded handgrip locations at the top of the climbers can be too large creating a strangulation hazard. A child's body could become lodged in these openings, posing a strangulation hazard. Units: About 200.

title: Walmart Recalls Camp Axes Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The axe head can detach from the handle, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 246,000.

title: Yamaha Recalls Golf Cars, Personal Transportation and Specialty Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The accelerator pedal return spring can break, posing a crash hazard. Units: 145000.

title: AAA Innovations Recalls Promotional Cooler/Grills Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The wooden cabinet surrounding the grill can catch fire, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 275.

title: UberScientific Recalls Topical Anesthetic Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Closure Requirement; Risk of Poisoning
summary: The packaging is not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The pain relieving cream and spray contain lidocaine, posing a risk of poisoning to young children if they put it on their skin or ingest it. Units: About 76,000.

title: Children's Toy Instrument Sets Recalled Due to Violation of the Federal Lead Paint Ban; Made by Creative Sto and Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: Paint on the maracas, xylophone and carrying case contains levels of lead that exceed the federal lead paint ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 440.

title: CB2 Recalls Pendant Lights Due to Fire and Shock Hazards
summary: The insulation on the electrical wiring can come loose, posing fire and shock hazards. Units: About 260.

title: Haier America Recalls Top-Mount Refrigerators Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An electrical component in the refrigerator can short circuit, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 137,000.

title: i play Recalls Infant Rattles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: Pieces of the rattle can detach, posing a choking hazard to infants. Units: About 6,100 (in addition, about 30 were sold in Canada).

title: Pacific Cycle Recalls Adult Men's Mountain Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The downtube on the bicycles can crack, posing a fall hazard Units: 17600.

title: Shadescapes Recalls Pool and Patio Umbrellas Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The umbrella arm can break while in use, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 200.

title: Shimano Recalls Bicycle Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury
summary: The bicycle helmets do not comply with the federal safety standard for bicycle helmets, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 4,200.

title: Waupaca Elevator Recalls to Inspect Elevators Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The elevator cab can fall unexpectedly to the bottom of the elevator shaft and abruptly stop, posing an injury hazard to consumers in the elevator cab. Units: About 8,000.

title: Cub Cadet Recalls Utility Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The fuel tank's neck can crack and cause fuel to leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 350.

title: Cub Cadet Recalls Zero-Turn Riding Mowers Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The fuel tank's neck can crack and cause fuel to leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 4,900 (in addition, about 1,300 were sold in Canada).

title: Yvolve Sports Recalls Electric Skateboards Due to to Fall Hazard; New Instructions and Warning Labels Provided
summary: The tire on the skateboard can deflate, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 10,000.

title: Huish Outdoors Recalls Buoyancy Control Devices (BCDs) Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: Buttons on the Zeagle Sport BCD inflators can break or fracture leading to a rapid loss of air or auto inflation of the BCD, posing a drowning hazard to scuba divers. Units: About 2,600 (In addition, about 800 were sold in Canada).

title: Brookstone Wireless Speakers Recalled Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The lithium ion batteries in the wireless speakers can overheat and catch fire, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 164,000.

title: Flushmate® Recalls Flushmate II 501-B Pressure-Assisted Flushing Systems Due to Impact and Laceration Hazards
summary: The system can burst at or near the vessel weld seam releasing stored pressure. This pressure can lift the tank lid and shatter the tank, posing impact and laceration hazards to consumers and property damage. title: Hydrolevel Recalls Controllers for Slant/Fin Boilers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: A malfunction in the recalled controller can cause the boiler to overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,900 (in addition, about 370 were sold in Canada).

title: Kikkerland Recalls Wireless Charger Bedside Pockets Due to Fire and Burn Hazard
summary: The wireless charger bedside pockets can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 3,600.

title: Vista Railing Systems Recalls ProBuilt Aluminum Posts Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The posts can separate from base, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 4,300 posts (in addition, about 23,500 were sold in Canada).

title: Abond Group Recalls Tubeez Baby Bath Support Seats Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The bath support seat fails to meet the federal safety standard including the requirements for stability. The bath seat can tip over or an infant can slip underneath the front support, posing a drowning hazard. Units: About 80 (in addition, about 5,109 were sold in Canada).

title: Gold Recalls Eddie Bauer Infant Carriers Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Target
summary: The buckles on the infant carriers can break, posing a fall hazard to children. Units: About 22,000.

title: CFMOTO Recalls Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The throttle pedal can be pushed past the throttle stop and not return to the idle position, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 1,800.

title: Fantasia Accessories Recalls Slap Bracelets Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Target
summary: The slap bracelet's metal wristband can pierce the protective fabric around it and expose sharp edges, posing a laceration hazard to young children. Units: About 22,500.
